subject: QuarkCloud onboarding: DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list & PO steps
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@quarkcloud.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: QuarkCloud (Request for onboarding docs & PO)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Procurement at QuarkCloud needs our onboarding checklist to finish vendor setup. Could you confirm the following so we can route a PO quickly?

- Do you have a current DPA we can sign, or will you accept our standard DPA?
- Link to Redwood's latest SOC 2 or equivalent security report (we need auditor name/date).
- Up-to-date subprocessor list (we must validate any cross-border subprocessors).
- Billing / invoice contact and PO instructions (supplier portal, email, invoice format).

Attached: QuarkCloud-Company-Profile.pdf (for your records).

If you can send the DPA and SOC2 link today, I can push this through our legal and finance teams this week.

Best,
Sara Lim
Vendor Ops | QuarkCloud Inc.
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

---
Attachment: QuarkCloud-Company-Profile.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@quarkcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: QuarkCloud (Request for onboarding docs & PO)

Sara — thanks, and glad to hear it. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) DPA: Attached is our current DPA (Redwood-DPA-v3.pdf). We can execute via DocuSign or return a countersigned PDF — whichever is faster for you. If you have redlines on data residency / subprocessors, loop in your legal and I'll bring Laura in to coordinate.

2) SOC 2: Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (for the period ending 2028-06-30) is hosted here: https://drive.redwood-inference.com/soc2/recent-report-2028.pdf. Auditor: Hartwell & Co. We can provide a restricted-access copy under NDA if your procurement requires it.

3) Subprocessors: Please send your subprocessor validation file; I'll compare against our list. We typically provide a CSV export (name, service, location, data processed).

4) PO / invoicing: Standard PO flow — we will create PO in our procurement portal once terms are agreed. Billing contact for Redwood is ap@redwood-inference.com. Invoice should reference PO number and be sent to that email. Portal: https://app.redwood-inference.com/procurement/portal/QC-2028-09-72

Next actions:
- Sara: please attach your subprocessor list and indicate preferred DPA signing method.
- Ben: I cc'd you to confirm commercial terms and finalize initial PO amount.
- Laura: leaving legal tag for any DPA redlines.

Attached: Redwood-DPA-v3.pdf (standard Redwood supplier DPA).

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
